literal_meaning: কলার পোড়া অংশ (banana's burnt or fibrous husk)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি কলাপোড়া খেয়েছো, এটা তো ফাঁকি ছিল।
সে আমাকে কলাপোড়া খাওয়ালো, কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: You've been fed a kalapoda; it was just a trick.
He made me eat kalapoda; there's no benefit at all.
history: Originating from rural Bengali traditions where offering the worthless fibrous husk of a banana instead of the fruit symbolizes deception or giving nothing of value.
note: The idiom often implies being fooled with something insignificant.
